top_signals.title: Stocks Rise as Oil Declines, Yen Slips Before BOJ: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks and bonds edged up as a pullback in oil prices eased inflation concerns. The yen slipped modestly ahead of the Bank of Japan’s interest-rate decision, with traders expecting a hike.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Approval rate for Takaichi Cabinet falls to 44.1%, poll shows
top_signals.summary: The survey found that 68.6% of respondents opposed a decision to appoint lawmakers involved in a slush fund scandal to key party or Cabinet posts.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
